description: Free. Return released and held jurisdiction and operation coverage without querying property records. Use this to plan routing; use resolve_jurisdiction when you have a specific address.

inputSchema.description: Identify the LocalProof jurisdiction whose coverage or source metadata should be returned.

city.description: Optional city name used when jurisdiction_id is not supplied.

jurisdiction_id.description: Canonical LocalProof jurisdiction identifier returned by resolve_jurisdiction or get_coverage.

state.description: Optional state name or abbreviation paired with city. Current released jurisdictions are in California.

name: localproof.get_coverage
title: Get Coverage
